Account access

Sign in with wallet first, email second.

PHN accounts should be wallet-native because staking, presale, vesting and node ownership are on-chain. Email/password is staged for support and non-custodial profile access after a backend is connected.

Email and password

Email auth should use Supabase, Firebase Auth, or another audited auth backend. The site must not store passwords in browser storage or static files.

Access model

How users should enter PHN

Connect wallet

MetaMask or Binance Wallet signs the user into the peaq network without sharing private keys.

Buy, stake or activate

The same wallet can use presale, staking, PHN wallet, node activation and vesting pages.

Add email profile later

Email is useful for support tickets and notifications, but on-chain ownership remains wallet-based.
